text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-21, a bug was fixed in search/query/rewriter.ts involving empty result sets in query rewrites.","The empty result set bug manifested specifically for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","The bug could be reproduced by searching for a two-word phrase containing a stop word.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was being shared across multiple function calls.","The fix involved making the default empty and constructing the value fresh for each call.","The fix was submitted as PR #3598 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1.","This fix reduced a flaky test failure rate from 37 failures per 100 runs down to zero.","The work addressed a recurring issue in the same corner of search/query/rewriter.ts where previous empty result set bugs had been fixed."]}
